verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to version, review, or roll back automations such as /loop jobs, hooks, skills, or headless scripts. Session checkpoints that restore files (grok-build-docs-14) roll back a coding conversation, not an automation definition. `grok inspect` only lists discovered hooks and skills, which is an adjacent visibility feature rather than review or versioning. Keeping config files in git would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
